newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Airlines said still mulling ticket price rise.
newsitem.headline: Airlines said still mulling ticket price rise.

text.p: International airline officials on Friday went into their third day of discussions on a possible joint decision to raise prices for passengers to make up for rising fuel costs, industry sources said.

The officials, known as tariff coordinators, are holding what was billed as an emergency meeting on the issue at the Geneva headquarters of the global airlines body, the International Air Transport Association (IATA).
There had been signs that the meeting might wrap up on Thursday night. "But they're still in there, and it could go on till the end of the day," said one source.
Some European carriers have already announced ticket price hikes, but there is believed to be resistance from North American and Asian airlines.
Fuel prices, around 10 per cent of most airlines' costs, have risen 30 per cent this year.
